boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the Baltimore Avenue/US 1 and campus-edge corridors, each with a specific documented reason to stop.

cards.title: The Board and Brew: play from a large game collection
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor
cards.notes: Meet at 8150 Baltimore Ave, then choose a party, strategy, or dexterity game from the cafe’s documented board-game collection.
cards.short_summary: A named Baltimore Avenue cafe with games as the activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Board and Brew’s College Park location is at 8150 Baltimore Ave and describes a collection of party, strategy, and dexterity games.
cards.source_title: The Board and Brew — College Park
cards.access_notes: Food and game use may require purchase; check the venue’s current policies before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The Hotel at the University of Maryland
cards.title: The Hotel at the University of Maryland: pause in the public lobby
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor
cards.notes: Use the accessible public entrance at 7777 Baltimore Ave as a clearly marked campus-edge meeting point before continuing on Route 1.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-edge building with an accessible public entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hotel at the University of Maryland lists 7777 Baltimore Ave and states that its public entrance and lobby-area amenities are accessible.
cards.source_title: The Hotel at the University of Maryland — Hotel Amenities
cards.access_notes: Lobby access is public; services and dining have separate costs and policies.

cards.title: Bagels 'n Grinds: a bagel-and-coffee stop
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor, inside The Hotel at UMD
cards.notes: At 7777 Baltimore Ave, use the hotel-lobby cafe for its documented bagel, coffee, breakfast, lunch, sandwich, and soup offerings.
cards.short_summary: A named hotel-lobby cafe with a documented daytime menu.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hotel at the University of Maryland identifies Bagels ’n Grinds as a lobby cafe serving coffee plus breakfast and lunch options including bagels, sandwiches, and soup.
cards.source_title: The Hotel at the University of Maryland — Dine & Drink

cards.title: Potomac Pizza: see College Park history on the walls
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor, inside The Hotel at UMD
cards.notes: At the 7777 Baltimore Ave hotel complex, visit the family restaurant whose official description notes College Park history displayed on its walls.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza restaurant with a documented College Park-history display.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hotel at the University of Maryland describes Potomac Pizza as a family restaurant with walls adorned with College Park history.
cards.source_title: The Hotel at the University of Maryland — Dine & Drink

cards.title: Iron Rooster: choose a family-style Southern meal
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor, inside The Hotel at UMD
cards.notes: At the 7777 Baltimore Ave hotel complex, use the official menu description to plan a meal around chicken and waffles, biscuits, or pancakes.
cards.short_summary: A named hotel-complex restaurant with documented Southern-style dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hotel at the University of Maryland lists Iron Rooster and describes chicken and waffles, biscuits with gravy, French toast, and buttermilk pancakes.
cards.source_title: The Hotel at the University of Maryland — Dine & Drink

cards.title: GrillMarX: a sit-down dinner option
cards.subtitle: Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor, inside The Hotel at UMD
cards.notes: At 7777 Baltimore Ave, use this named restaurant for a seated meal; its official page lists burgers, fish sandwiches, salads, steaks, and seafood.
cards.short_summary: A named hotel-lobby restaurant with a documented full dinner menu.
cards.evidence_claim: GrillMarX is listed at 7777 Baltimore Ave, College Park, with burgers, fish sandwiches, salads, steaks, and seafood on its described menu.
cards.source_title: GrillMarX — The Hotel at the University of Maryland

cards.title: Old Parish House: find an early-1800s city building
cards.subtitle: Knox Road, one block east of the Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor
cards.notes: Walk to 4711 Knox Road to view this city-owned building; check the College Park Arts Exchange schedule before planning an event visit.
cards.short_summary: A named historic city facility near the Route 1 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: College Park identifies the Old Parish House at 4711 Knox Road as a city-owned facility built in the early 1800s, with prime tenancy granted to College Park Arts Exchange.
cards.source_title: City of College Park — City Facilities
cards.access_notes: Public access depends on scheduled programming or reservations; exterior viewing does not require admission.

cards.title: College Park Aviation Museum: see aircraft and aviation objects
cards.subtitle: Campus Drive corridor, reached from Baltimore Avenue (US 1)
cards.notes: Follow Campus Drive to 1985 Corporal Frank Scott Drive and explore the museum’s aircraft and early-aviation objects during posted museum hours.
cards.short_summary: A named aviation museum with aircraft-focused exhibits beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Park Aviation Museum is at 1985 Corporal Frank Scott Drive and has an exhibit area highlighting ten aircraft and objects relating to early aviation.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; it also states walk-in admission is free through December 31, 2026.

cards.title: Calvert Hills Playground & Athletic Field: an outdoor pause
cards.subtitle: Calvert Road corridor, beside the Baltimore Avenue (US 1) corridor
cards.notes: Use the city-listed playground and athletic field as an outdoor stop off Calvert Road, then return to the nearby Route 1 corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named city playground and athletic field near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of College Park lists Calvert Hills Playground & Athletic Field among its parks and playgrounds.
cards.source_title: City of College Park — Calvert Hills Playground & Athletic Field
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public facility; follow posted field-use rules.

cards.title: College Park–University of Maryland Station: connect to rail and bus
cards.subtitle: River Road corridor, beside the north Baltimore Avenue (US 1) approach
cards.notes: Use the named station as a transit waypoint for Metrorail and Metrobus connections; confirm service details before departure.
cards.short_summary: A named transit destination at the campus-edge Route 1 approach.
cards.evidence_claim: WMATA identifies College Park–University of Maryland as a Metrorail station serving the College Park area.
cards.source_title: WMATA — College Park–University of Maryland Station
cards.access_notes: Fares apply for transit rides; station access itself does not require admission.
